On every switch the trusted port must be the one leading to the legitimate DHCP server – the controller works it out from the topology (MNDP/LLDP neighbours). strings.Konfiguraci zařízení nastavuje controlle: The device configuration is set by the controller according to the site intent (since {0}). Changes to networks or exceptions take effect through reconciliation.
strings.Převzetí smaže současnou konfiguraci a n: Takeover erases the current configuration and deploys it from scratch according to the site intent. A backup is made first; if the device does not report back over the tunnel within 12 minutes after takeover, it restores itself from it.
strings.Převzetí smaže současnou konfiguraci rou: Takeover erases the router's current configuration and deploys a clean one: WAN, site networks with DHCP, NAT and a zone-based firewall. A backup is taken first; if the gateway does not reach the controller within 12 minutes after takeover, it restores itself from that backup.
